method: GPU back-buffer readback of a hidden GPUI window (Window::capture_frame)
method_notes: the pixels come from the hidden window's own DirectX back buffer; the screen, the desktop and other applications are never read
the window is created with show:false and focus:false and is never activated, moved to the foreground or asked for input
a shot is accepted only after the scenario reports its state and two consecutive readbacks are byte-identical

isolation.network: nothing dialled: no SSH connection, ProxyCommand, PTY or user command is started

evidence_boundary: the sessions in the shots are display-only fixtures; a PNG of a page is not proof that the page works
only the Windows DirectX readback path is exercised; macOS and Linux capture is unverified
the text is rendered with the fonts installed on this machine, so a pixel comparison across machines is not meaningful
no layout selector is read: a scenario confirms arrival from the same model the render reads, not from where a pixel landed
foreground_note: another application took the foreground during the run (40307566 -> 61147922); the hidden capture window was never shown

shots.title: 首页 · 已保存的主机与分组
shots.fixture: six saved hosts in three groups, seeded on disk before the view starts
shots.evidence_boundary: shows the list this build draws; the hosts were never connected and no group tree exists yet

shots.title: 主机 · 五千台的可扫描列表
shots.fixture: five thousand saved hosts in four groups, written to the run's own root before the view starts
shots.evidence_boundary: shows the list this build draws and the filters above it; the list is asked for the rows it shows, so the shot cannot show how many elements exist. No host was connected, so no connection state is part of it

shots.title: 主机 · 层级分组树与分组行
shots.fixture: the same five thousand hosts, grouped Prod/Web, Prod/DB, Prod/Edge and Staging in the grouped view
shots.evidence_boundary: shows the group column and the group headers of the list; opening and closing a group is not part of the shot, and no group was created or moved by it

shots.title: 本地终端 · 会话与标签
shots.fixture: one display-only session fed a fixed transcript; no PTY or shell ran
shots.evidence_boundary: proves terminal layout, colour and text rendering; proves nothing about a live shell, its environment or its keystrokes

shots.title: 终端 · 多标签与后台提醒
shots.fixture: two display-only shells and one saved host's terminal, the second tab carrying a background bell
shots.evidence_boundary: proves the merged head names the current tab once, and that another tab's bell is marked while it is not the one on screen; no shell, SSH session or bell from a real program is part of it

shots.title: 终端 · 左右分屏
shots.fixture: one session split left and right, the second pane holding a second display-only session
shots.evidence_boundary: proves a split marks its panes and its active pane without repeating the session; the second pane has no process behind it

shots.title: 终端 · 连接断开
shots.fixture: a saved host's display-only terminal, ended the way a lost connection ends
shots.evidence_boundary: proves the state, the reason and the next step are readable on the merged head; no connection was ever made, so no transport behaviour is shown

shots.title: 文件 · 本机与服务器双栏
shots.fixture: both file sources answered from fixture listings; nothing was read from disk or a server
shots.evidence_boundary: shows the two columns, their own paths, the actions each row offers and the direction between them; no directory was really listed, so no permission or server behaviour is shown

shots.title: 传输 · 进行中与速率
shots.fixture: one transfer in the strip, started and progressed through the queue's own events
shots.evidence_boundary: shows the share, the measured speed and the time left of a task this build holds; no byte was moved and no connection took part

shots.title: 传输 · 失败与重试
shots.fixture: one transfer failed the way a lost connection stops it: it left a partial file
shots.evidence_boundary: shows the reason, the partial file and the retry actions of a task the queue really holds; no transfer was attempted

shots.title: 转发 · 三种类型与运行状态
shots.fixture: three saved rules - local, remote and SOCKS - with the first marked as listening
shots.evidence_boundary: shows the kind, the host each rule goes through, which side each endpoint is on and the state of every row; no socket was bound and no connection exists

shots.title: 设置 · 分类导航与外观
shots.evidence_boundary: shows the category and item navigation and the one page it opens; the values are this build's defaults and no preference was written

shots.title: 设置 · 快捷键子页
shots.fixture: default preferences; every action at its default binding
shots.evidence_boundary: shows the search, the scope filter and the bindings in force on the shortcut page alone; pressing a control is not part of the shot

shots.title: 批量任务 · 确认前的目标与命令
shots.fixture: six saved hosts with four selected, two ordered commands, concurrency 4 and the skip-host policy
shots.evidence_boundary: shows the preview this build draws before anything is confirmed: the count of targets, their addresses, the commands and the limits. No session was opened and no command was sent, which is what the shot cannot show but the model proves

shots.title: 批量任务 · 运行中的逐机逐步状态
shots.fixture: the real batch runner over four hosts and two commands, two hosts finished and two held inside the second command by the fixture gate
shots.evidence_boundary: shows the states, exit results, output and timeline the runner reported; the transport is a fixture, so this is not evidence about any SSH server

shots.title: 批量任务 · 失败的主机与重试
shots.fixture: the same runner over four hosts, where one command exits 3 on one host and the other hosts succeed
shots.evidence_boundary: shows the failed host, its exit status and reason, the untouched hosts and the retry action; no rollback is claimed, because none happens
